title: Shipment Tracking SOP
brief: How the operations desk tracks a shipment from booking to delivery, what each status (in_transit, held, delayed, delivered) means, and how often scans are refreshed (every 30 minutes at hubs). Include the shipment id format TG- followed by six digits and the rule that delivered shipments cannot be rerouted.

title: Delay Escalation SOP
brief: When and how delays are escalated. A shipment more than 24 hours late is escalated to the account manager, and over 48 hours to the hub operations lead. State the contact steps, the notification to the shipper within 2 hours of escalation, and the low, medium and high ETA confidence levels.

title: Reroute SOP
brief: The procedure for rerouting a shipment through the alternate hub on its contract. State that the alternate hub must not be closed and must accept reroutes, that a human approval is required, that a reroute is logged with the before and after record, and that a delivered shipment cannot be rerouted. Include the reroute fee waiver when the delay is caused by a Tallowgate hub closure, and the 2 hour approval target.

title: Hub Directory
brief: The six hubs: KRN Kernmoor Central (cutoff 17:30, utilisation target under 80 percent), MAV Mavisgate Cross-dock (18:00), HLM Holmquay Port Terminal (16:00, congested, no reroutes), TRB Tarnwick Gate Depot (19:00), WYN Wyncliff Rail Yard (15:00, closed for yard works), ORS Orsley Park Sorting Centre (20:00). Give each hub an invented district and its main role.

title: Carrier Contract Summary CC-17
brief: Summary of contract CC-17 with the invented carrier Greywater Haulage: next-day service within the home region, liability of 8.50 per kilogram, claim window of 21 days, alternate hub arrangements, and a pickup cutoff of 16:00.

title: Carrier Contract Summary CC-22
brief: Summary of contract CC-22 with the invented carrier Bellmoor Linehaul: two-day service, liability of 12.00 per kilogram, claim window of 21 days, temperature-controlled option, and a damage inspection requirement within 48 hours.

title: Carrier Contract Summary CC-31
brief: Summary of contract CC-31 with the invented carrier Ostrander Freightways: economy three-day service, liability of 6.00 per kilogram, claim window of 21 days, limits on single piece weight (1,000 kilograms), and an optional upgrade to insured cover.

title: Cargo Claims Procedure
brief: How to lodge a cargo claim: within 21 days of delivery (or expected delivery for lost cargo), required evidence (photos, delivery note, packing list), review by the claims team within 10 working days, and how liability per kilogram is applied by contract. Include the minimum claim value of 25.

title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance Policy
brief: Generic acceptance rules. Refused: class 1 explosives, class 6.2 infectious substances and class 7 radioactive material. Accepted only with prior booking and paperwork: class 3 flammable liquids, class 8 corrosives, class 9 miscellaneous in limited quantities. State the 48 hour notice needed for accepted classes.

title: Packaging and Pallet Standards
brief: Packaging rules: maximum pallet height of 1.8 metres including load, maximum pallet weight of 800 kilograms, footprint of 1.2 by 1.0 metres, stretch wrapping, corner boards for glass and tile, labelling on two adjacent sides with the shipment id, and handling marks.

title: Customs Paperwork Checklist
brief: Checklist for cross-border lanes between invented regions Northreach, Eastmere and the Southern Reaches: commercial invoice, packing list, origin declaration, 2 working days lead time for filing, and the hold rule when paperwork is incomplete (shipment status becomes held).

title: Peak Season Surcharge Notice
brief: Notice of a 4.5 percent peak season surcharge on the freight charge from 2026-11-16 to 2026-12-24, which lanes it applies to (all domestic and cross-border lanes), exemptions for contracts on fixed-rate schedules (none for CC-31), and the booking cut-off recommendation of 2026-12-10 for pre-holiday delivery.

title: Holiday Operating Schedule
brief: Hub and desk hours for the holidays: all hubs closed on 2026-12-25, reduced collections on 2026-12-24 (last pickup 12:00) and 2026-12-26 (limited linehaul), the operations desk open 24/7 throughout, account managers closed on 2026-12-25 and 2026-12-26.

title: Shipper Onboarding FAQ
brief: Frequently asked questions for new shippers: how to open an account, how contract codes are assigned, how the alternate hub is chosen, how to find shipment ids, invoice cycles of 30 days, and how the customer portal works.
